results.content: Human resources (HR) is the part of an organization that is in charge of finding, vetting, hiring, and training job candidates, as well as running benefit programmers for employees. Human resources are in charge of things like pay and benefits, hiring, firing, and staying up-to-date on any laws that might affect the company's employees. * Human resources (HR) is the division of an organization that is responsible for recruiting, screening, hiring, and training new employees, as well as administering employee benefits. The human resources department in a company or institution is in charge of employee records, business benefits, hiring, and training, among other things. Human resources is essential for effective organizational management, attracting, hiring, and retaining talented employees, managing employee benefits, compensation, and performance evaluations, mitigating legal risks, fostering a fair work environment, and enhancing communication between management and employees.
